item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 05/May/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring slightly cooler weather to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise progressively over the coast of southern China in the following couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to form over central China on Thursday and edge closer to the coast of southern China on Friday. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week.
